offering_description.value: Palomar sells earthquake, casualty, inland marine and property, crop, and surety and credit coverage to individuals and businesses. It uses specialized underwriting and data analytics to assess risks and writes policies nationwide.

quotes.quote: Palomar is a specialty insurance company that provides property and casualty insurance products to individuals and businesses. We leverage underwriting expertise and data-driven analytics to offer innovative solutions in five product categories: Earthquake, Casualty, Inland Marine and Property, Crop and Surety and Credit. Our underwriting and analytical expertise allow us to concentrate on certain markets that we believe are underserved and can generate attractive risk-adjusted returns.
Palomar is headquartered in La Jolla, California, writing business nationwide.

Elizabeth Seitz serves as EVP Treasury and Financial Operations of Palomar. Since its inception she has provided GAAP and Statutory accounting and operational guidance. Prior to joining Palomar, she served as VP – Controller of Arrowhead General Insurance Agency, Inc., which she joined. Ms. Seitz was a Tax Manager at PricewaterhouseCoopers and is a California Certified Public Accountant. She earned a BA in Mathematics from Vanderbilt University and an MS in Accountancy with a specialization in Taxation from San Diego State University.
